name: Carnahans'
description: In Fayetteville, GA, Carnahans' raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Grapes on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
